## Freed v26.9.1700-dev

Incremental Desktop and PWA operation catch-up, report durable consumer synchronization progress, and native Library joining and consumer enforcement

### Features

- Incremental Desktop and PWA operation catch-up
- Report durable consumer synchronization progress
- Native Library joining and consumer enforcement

### Fixes

- Reader, feed, and header polish
- Sync and update reliability fixes
- Release build and type-safety cleanup
- Shared package test coverage in integration restored

### Follow-ups

- Define Vorton Factory repository configuration
- Label reader focus mode and explain its purpose
- Remove repeated release validation and setup
- Cross-compile Intel releases on Apple Silicon
- Reverse-integrate v26.9.803 and publish README showcase
- Yield during desktop mock snapshot encoding
- Isolate desktop scroll benchmark overhead
- Refine themed showcase animations
- Group nearby stories and unify sample population
- Enforce initiative and decision review
- Compact map cards and preserve location markers
- Migrate OpenAI defaults to GPT-6 Astra
- 500 post demo corpus

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
